'''Minder Nine''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Minder (Imperial Intelligence)|Minder]] within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Like all Minders, he processed information from [[Cipher Agent]]s, like when he relayed [[Cipher Four]]'s report on the situation on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to [[Watcher Three]].
